name: LoveSpark Clipboard Notes
summary: Paste clipboard into timestamped notes. 7-day retention, never lose copied text. Lightweight, free, private.
detailed_description:
Never lose something you copied again.

You copy a link, switch tabs, copy something else, and the first thing is gone forever. For ADHD brains juggling multiple contexts, the clipboard is a single-slot bottleneck that constantly loses important information. LoveSpark Clipboard Notes turns your clipboard into a timestamped note stream with 7-day retention, so nothing you copy disappears.

FEATURES

- Paste clipboard content into timestamped notes with one click
- 7-day automatic retention — old notes clean themselves up
- Chronological note stream showing everything you've saved
- Timestamps on every note so you know when you copied it
- Quick-paste from any note back to your clipboard
- Track how many notes you've saved today and total
- Automatic cleanup — no manual maintenance needed
- Lightweight — minimal storage footprint
- 4 cozy themes: Retro Pink, Dark Noir, Warm Beige, Cool Slate
- Full keyboard navigation and screen reader support

HOW IT WORKS

1. Copy something important — a link, a snippet, a quote
2. Click the Clipboard Notes icon
3. Your clipboard content is saved as a timestamped note
4. Need it later? Find it in your note stream and copy it back
5. Notes older than 7 days auto-delete to keep things clean

WHY LOVESPARK

LoveSpark is built by a neurodivergent developer who has lost countless important clipboard items to the void. Clipboard Notes is intentionally simple — it's not a full note-taking app. It's a safety net for your clipboard. The 7-day auto-cleanup prevents it from becoming another overwhelming backlog.

Every LoveSpark extension is free, open source, and privacy-first. Your clipboard content stays on your device.

PRIVACY FIRST

LoveSpark Clipboard Notes stores all data locally in your browser. We collect zero data. No analytics. No tracking. No ads. No account required. Your data never leaves your device.

OPEN SOURCE

This extension is open source under the MIT license. View the code at github.com/Joona-t/lovespark-extensions/tree/main/productivity/lovespark-clipboard-notes.

Part of the LoveSpark suite — free retro pink tools for neurodivergent minds.
